video.title: Memphis Grizzlies Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

summary: Josh Lloyd previews the 2026-27 Memphis Grizzlies for fantasy. He thinks the team is still fairly bad. He also expects coach Tuomas Iisalo's short-stint style to produce a deep, crowded rotation, maybe 11 or 12 players. His projected starters are Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey. The bench is Scotty Pippen Jr., Jaylen Wells, Isaiah Stewart, GG Jackson and Cam Spencer. His best targets are Ty Jerome at his Yahoo ADP of about 115 and Zach Edey at his ESPN ADP of about 124. Boozer should be the best fantasy rookie and a top-35 player late in the season, though his Yahoo rank of 51 is maybe a bit high. Pippen is his late-round swing pick and Isaiah Stewart is his stash as Edey's injury insurance. The schedule is very good: a maxed 4-4-4 through March 28 and only 13 back-to-backs.
